messages:
Ava (People Ops): quick q — Sam mentioned he and his partner want to split parental leave across months and keep Sam on a part-time schedule for first 6 weeks. what paperwork + payroll steps do we need?
Sam H: yes — planning to do 4w full leave then 6w 50% remote/part-time. partner will take some leave too. wondering about state STD + company top-up timing.
Ava (People Ops): ok. two tracks: statutory/state short term disability (STD) + company parental top-up. employee needs to submit STD claim (if applicable) ASAP — that determines base pay replacement window. then we run the parental top-up for the agreed period.
Ava (People Ops): action items for Sam: 1) start STD claim at your state's portal, 2) upload the claim confirmation to our HR portal, 3) complete the Redwood parental leave form: https://hr.redwood.ai/forms/parental-leave
Sam H: timeline question — if STD pays starting 2 weeks after birth, but I want 4w full pay from Redwood, how does that calc?
Ava (People Ops): Redwood top-up bridges the difference between STD and 100% for the covered full-pay weeks. example: STD = 60% after waiting period; Redwood pays 40% top-up for the first 4 weeks you selected as full-pay. payroll team needs the STD confirmation and the signed leave dates by payroll cutoff (Mon of the pay week before leave).
Lee W: manager logistics: do we need a formal handoff doc? I can cover on-call for the first two weeks but want a checklist.
Rina (Manager): I can help with a phased schedule for Sam. also concerned about backlog and sprint commitments.
Ava (People Ops): yes — please use this mini-handover template and attach to the leave request: ```Handover checklist:
- Priority bugs + owners
- Running experiments + snapshot links
- On-call runbook + escalation contact
- Access/keys transfer (short-term)
- Expected check-in cadence if part-time return```
Sam H: tagging payroll: @time-off-bot can we confirm payroll cutoff dates?
time-off-bot: Payroll cutoff for leave starting in the week of 2028-06-15 is 2028-06-09 23:59 PT. Please upload STD docs and the signed parental form before that.
Ava (People Ops): international note — Sam, if partner is taking UK Shared Parental Leave or you're on an international contract, we do a local-country benefits check. ping me your partner's country if relevant.
Sam H: partner is on UK employer plan, I'm US-based. ok to proceed with US STD + Redwood top-up for my portion.
Rina (Manager): coverage plan: Lee will take urgent bugs, I’ll own release merge approvals first two weeks, + we’ll rotate reviews. Sam pls add owners to the checklist.
Lee W: got it. Sam — can you add a short doc with steps to repro current flaky test? saves time.
Sam H: will add repro + test tag by EOD. also — gear/equipment handoff: I need to move my laptop to be available to the backup. what's the formal process?
Ava (People Ops): equipment: submit an asset transfer in the console: https://assets.redwood.ai/transfer — Security approves same-day for short-term handoffs. mention 'parental coverage' in notes and we'll expedite.
Ava (People Ops): last item — lactation room scheduling: if you plan occasional office visits, reserve room here: https://offices.redwood.ai/lactation 
Sam H: perfect. I'll start the STD claim today and upload the docs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ava (People Ops): want me to review your filled parental form before you submit? happy to do a quick pass.
Sam H: yes please — I’ll DM when done.
Rina (Manager): thanks team.  :heart:
Ava (People Ops): filing note: once docs are in, HR will send the top-up confirmation email with dates and payroll amounts. expect that within 3 business days of submission.
time-off-bot: Leave request 1825009876 status updated: docs received (STD confirmation). Next step: HR review.
Sam H: received — appreciate the fast turnaround!
